rationale: The observed ledgers establish bounded event sequences for the comparison drafts. Sharing a ledger template does not establish that those sequences apply to the focal draft. The mapping supplies no unresolved empirical relation that would warrant that transfer; its operational conditions merely require applicability.

signal_basis.exact_text: Panel A has a continuous reliable ledger and witnessed attachments placing its identified opening-section assembly before its dated binding event. Panel B has a continuous reliable ledger and witnessed attachments placing its identified closing-section replacement after its dated editorial review.
Each panel tracks identified leaves of its assigned draft; a matching ledger form does not stipulate that two drafts contain the same events.
Ledger-template identity is the only stated cross-draft connection; shared authorship, leaf identity and assembly dates are not stipulated.
